class.name: SteamPublisherInventory
class.brief_description: Reads and changes Steam Inventory through a trusted publisher.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamPublisher.inventory] in a trusted publisher build with Economy permissions for the configured AppID. Use identities verified by that exact publisher. Foreign identities return [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED], invalid arguments return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER], and unavailable scopes return [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. Before calling a write, have the game authorize the action and durably bind its unique request ID to the complete award or consumption intent. After a timeout, a closed observation, or an unrecognized reply, reconcile Steam inventory before retrying with the same request ID and arguments. A Valve replay reports the current state of the affected items.

method.name: consume
method.description: Awaits a [SteamInventoryChangeResult] for the permanent consumption of a positive unsigned 32-bit [param quantity] from [param player]'s [param instance_id]. Supply the same nonzero unsigned decimal [param request_id] for a retry of the same authorized operation. A recognized confirmation includes exactly one changed or removed row for the requested stack.

method.name: grant
method.description: Awaits a [SteamInventoryChangeResult] for a game-authorized award to [param player]. Supply 1 to 256 published [param definition_ids] and a nonzero unsigned decimal [param request_id]. The result contains the actual item rows Steam reports after bundle and generator expansion. Repeat the same request ID and definitions for a retry of this award.

method.name: items
method.description: Awaits a [SteamInventorySnapshotResult] for the configured app and verified [param player]. The typed rows are detached and read-only. The publisher endpoint supplies no snapshot freshness evidence.

method.name: start_trade
method.description: Awaits a [SteamTradeSessionResult] for a Steam trade request in an eligible Economy app. Verify the distinct [param player] and [param partner] in the same publisher and confirm their consent in the game before calling. A recognized Steam acknowledgment identifies both accounts. The participants confirm any transfer through Steam.
